name: Rainier Woodworking Co
old_description: We will create the right solution from your vision, or we can surprise you with a finished product that you wont be disappointed with.
about:
Rainier Woodworking Co operates from a facility at 2615 South 80th Street in Tacoma, Washington. The company has served the Greater Puget Sound region for many years, producing cabinetry for local designers and dealers. Its roots are in the Pacific Northwest, where it has built a reputation for locally made wood products.

The shop manufactures a superior line of cabinetry sold exclusively through professional kitchen and bath designers and dealers along the West Coast. Production focuses on custom solutions built to client specifications, with an emphasis on heirloom-quality wood construction. The company also offers a design collaboration process, creating products from a client’s vision or delivering finished pieces.

Primary customers include independent kitchen and bath designers and dealerships that specify Rainier products for residential projects. The company also works directly with design professionals to develop custom pieces. Its distribution network spans the West Coast, serving professional designers and some of the best kitchen & bath dealers.

Rainier Woodworking highlights its commitment to fair pricing, working within client budgets and timelines. The company also stresses sustainable material sourcing, noting a deep regard for the trees that supply its wood, and offers a proprietary project-tracking app called RW CabTracker.
